The '''Darkwalker Cave''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Located a relatively short distance east of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the cave was under the control of a criminal organization known as the [[Darkwalkers]].<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" />

==History==
{{Quote|I need you to download some Darkwalker security codes from computers in their cave.|[[Toff Henrou]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DSTDW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Doing Skaak Tipper Dirty Work|Naboo}}</ref>}}
Among the cave's occupants included important Darkwalker leaders, including [[Bloodlord]] [[Marcus Gaw]], [[Underlord]] [[Critolus Masse]], and an aegis guard by the name of [[Solon Gaw]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Darkwalkers captured [[Karl Eckener]] and held him hostage within a [[Prison/Legends|holding cell]] inside the cave.<ref name="SWG:RKE" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Mercious Bragg|Bragg]] and the [[RSF Intelligence Division]] investigated the cave while searching for the responsibles of a [[Terrorist attack in Theed|terrorist attack]] in Theed.<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" /> In the meantime, the cave was attacked by [[Skaak Tippers|Skaak Tipper]] spacers led by [[Toff Henrou]].<ref name="SWG:DSTDW" />

Karl Eckener was eventually [[Rescue of Karl Eckener|freed]] by a [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] working for [[Hugo Eckener/Legends|Hugo Eckener]]. Marcus Gaw, Critolus Masse and Solon Gaw were killed during the assault.<ref name="SWG:RKE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Darkwalker Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Darkwalker Cave was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]],"<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
